children: engineers and technical employees, said on Wednesday that they recommended their members accept Boeing's latest contract offer.

Boeing and its engineering union reached a contract agreement this month, a four-year offer that includes higher general wage increases than the first offer which SPEEA members rejected in a August 21 vote.
